known_issues: Whole-text normalization is the unchanged semantic-section CR/LF/form-feed rule, not scientific interpretation or glyph visibility.
Source is captured by the existing bounded native-JSON snapshot before projection. Persistent changes are rechecked after each outer stage; concurrent mutate-and-restore behavior is unsupported.

The 300-second post-admission limit checks acceptance between synchronous outer stages and before return; it neither preempts an in-flight adapter nor interrupts the inner job. Existing inner per-call guards, timeout and disable switch remain effective.
Maximum 25 existing adapter invocations is not aggregate CPU/RSS/scratch accounting or a count of every descendant process.
The outer source-aware resource-profile hash is distinct from the separately pinned inner inspection-job profile hash; both are carried explicitly.
Sealed results contain unsigned metadata and caller-provided expectations, not cryptographically authenticated worker execution or report-release authority.
No durable checkpoint, resume, parallelism, retry, custom executor or caller receipt is accepted.
Default rendering/validation remains 32 pages and 8 MiB; optional 64-page composition does not activate long-report delivery.

64-page admission is conditional on every unchanged inner structural budget. A 64-heading automatic bookmark chain reaches effective graph depth 65 and is rejected by the existing depth-64 guard. Native 64-page positive fixtures omit automatic bookmarks at generation only; the original over-depth fixture remains a required negative control.
